place.source_title: Chinook Pier Park shops by the channel, Grand Haven

brief: A c. 1990 row of small timber shop buildings on a riverfront boardwalk by moored charter boats, with lamp posts and benches. One photo. Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: Chinook Pier Park (Grand Haven MI, c.1990): the photo shows mostly the channel -- empty dock piles and finger piers, a riverwalk with lamp posts and a bench, a historical marker, and the corner of one hip-roofed brick shop building; a power-plant stack across the river

why.note: 1980s-90s riverfront renewal: old fish docks turned into a park with charter-boat slips and little shops
